brief:
Georgian police deployed pepper spray against pro-Palestine supporters of Turkish club Besiktas during a Europa League match against Israeli side Hapoel Beer-Sheva on Thursday, Middle East Eye reported. The incident forced a 30-minute suspension of play.

The clash occurred as Besiktas fans displayed pro-Palestinian sentiment during the match in Georgia. Police response with chemical spray marked a sharp escalation in tensions surrounding the fixture.
